description: Independent review blocker: assign_team/unassign_team compute replacement arrays before row locking and overwrite concurrent merged memberships. Preserve system-team/noop/error contracts. Relevant People/team/merge/concurrency tests, mix format, mix q, git diff check. No commit/push/PR.
